function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the p-value? Actually they say "零假設檢定的標準差" maybe they want to compute the standard error? Wait: "以得到人口平均值為98.6" means "to get population mean 98.6". So we have sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40. Null hypothesis: population mean = 98.6. We need to compute the standard error? Or compute the t-statistic? That would be sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size). But they might want to compute the p-value. The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" could be "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? Actually "標準差" is standard deviation. But maybe they want to compute the standard error of the mean difference? Let's parse: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" Means "Calculate the standard deviation for the null hypothesis test with sample mean 98.2, standard deviation 1.4, sample size 40, to obtain population mean 98.6." That seems like they want to compute the standard error of the mean difference between sample and population? Actually the standard error of the sample mean is s/sqrt(n). That is 1.4/√40 ≈ 0.221. Then the t-statistic is (98.2 - 98.6)/0.221 ≈ -1.81. Then p-value two-tailed ~ 0.075. But the question might ask to compute the standard deviation of the sampling distribution of the mean difference? That is same as standard error. So answer: 0.221. But maybe they want to compute the p-value. The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might refer to the standard deviation used in the test statistic.
